item.title: Gold Price Rally Reshapes Autumn Buying Plans
item.dc:creator: Alan McCann
item.content:encoded:
The sustained gold price rally is reshaping autumn buying plans, with retailers leaning into 9ct lines.

Suppliers say made-to-order is cushioning margin pressure.
